lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hA3 : ContDiff ℝ 3 A := hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)
  have hJd : Differentiable ℝ J := hJ.differentiable (by simp)
  have hEc : ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y k) :=
    fun k => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := k) hA3 t
  have hB : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ (fun s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) :=
    fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j) (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ hA3 (j, i)) x
  have hJt : Differentiable ℝ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) :=
    LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time hJd x i
  have hlt {f g : Time → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (hg : Differentiable ℝ g) :
      ∂ₜ (fun s => a * f s - b * g s) t = a * ∂ₜ f t - b * ∂ₜ g t := by
    simp only [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub (hf.differentiableAt.const_mul a)
      (hg.differentiableAt.const_mul b), fderiv_const_mul hf.differentiableAt a,
      fderiv_const_mul hg.differentiableAt b, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hls {k : Fin d → Time → ℝ} (hk : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ (k j)) :
      ∂ₜ (fun s => ∑ j, k j s) t = ∑ j, ∂ₜ (k j) t :=
    Time.deriv_fun_sum Finset.univ k fun j _ => (hk j).differentiableAt
  have hdsub {f g : Space d → ℝ} (u : Fin d) (y : Space d) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f)
      (hg : Differentiable ℝ g) : ∂[u] (fun z => f z - g z) y = ∂[u] f y - ∂[u] g y :=
    congrFun (Space.deriv_sub f g hf hg) y
  have hdsm {f : Space d → ℝ} (c : ℝ) (u : Fin d) (y : Space d) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) :
      ∂[u] (fun z => c * f z) y = c * ∂[u] f y :=
    congrFun (Space.deriv_const_smul c hf) y
  have hds {k : Fin d → Space d → ℝ} (u : Fin d) (y : Space d)
      (hk : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ (k j)) :
      ∑ j, ∂[u] (k j) y = ∂[u] (fun z => ∑ j, k j z) y := by
    simp only [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (hk j).differentiableAt,
      FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
  have hG : (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) =
      fun y => (1 / 𝓕.ε₀) * J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t y :=
    funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1.trans
      (by simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm, mul_one])
  have hB2 : ∀ j, ∂ₜ (fun s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) t
      = ∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x - ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x := by
    intro j
    rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ hA3 (j, i)) t x,
      show (fun y => ∂ₜ (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c · y (j, i)) t) = _ from
        funext fun y => time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t y j i,
      hdsub j x (Space.deriv_differentiable (hEc i) j) (Space.deriv_differentiable (hEc j) i),
      Space.deriv_commute _ (hEc j)]
  have hQ : ∑ j, ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x
      = 1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x := by
    rw [hds i x fun j => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEc j) j, hG, hdsm (1 / 𝓕.ε₀) i x
      (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space hJd t)]
  have h1 : ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) = fun s =>
      1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i :=
    funext fun s => (Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
      (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) x) s).trans
      (time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h s x i)
  have h2 : ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t
      = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
    rw [h1, hlt (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hB j) hJt, hls hB]
    simp only [hB2]
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_sub, hQ]
  have hcm : 𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ = 1 / 𝓕.ε₀ :=
    by rw [𝓕.c_sq, div_mul_eq_mul_div, mul_div_mul_right _ _ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero]
  rw [h2, mul_comm 𝓕.μ₀ 𝓕.ε₀, ← 𝓕.c_sq, hcm]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul, mul_assoc]

lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  ext x₀
  by_contra hx0
  have hpos₀ : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne' real_inner_self_nonneg' (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx0)
  have hc : Continuous fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := by fun_prop
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hpos⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
    (hc.continuousAt.eventually_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds hpos₀))
  let φ : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 2, δ, half_pos hδ, half_lt_self hδ⟩
  have hφ : IsTestFunction φ := ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩
  have key := hg (fun x => φ x • f x₀) (by fun_prop)
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at key
  have hcf := φ.continuous.mul hc
  have hnonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := fun x => by
    by_cases hx : dist x x₀ < δ
    · exact mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (hpos x hx).le
    · rw [φ.zero_of_le_dist (not_lt.mp hx), zero_mul]
  exact (mul_pos (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)) hpos₀).ne'
    (congrFun (Measure.eq_of_ae_eq
        ((integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hnonneg
          (hcf.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport φ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right)).mp key) hcf
        continuous_const) x₀)

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have hd := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var | abs | tabs | sub => grind
  case inl der _ ih => exact (ih rfl der).imp (·.inl) fun h => ⟨_, h.choose_spec.inl⟩
  case inr der _ ih => exact (ih rfl der).imp (·.inr) fun h => ⟨_, h.choose_spec.inr⟩
  case app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    rcases ih_l rfl l with v | h
    · rcases ih_r rfl r with w | h'
      · rcases l.canonical_form_abs v with ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨_, .abs v.lc w⟩
      · exact ⟨_, .appᵣ v h'.choose_spec⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 h.choose_spec⟩
  case tapp der sub ih =>
    right
    rcases ih rfl der with v | h
    · rcases der.canonical_form_tabs v with ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨_, .tabs v.lc sub.wf.2.1.lc⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .tapp sub.wf.2.1.lc h.choose_spec⟩
  case let' der _ ih _ =>
    right
    obtain ⟨_, b⟩ := body_let.mp hd.wf.2.1
    rcases ih rfl der with v | h
    · exact ⟨_, .let_body v b⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .let_bind h.choose_spec b⟩
  case case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    obtain ⟨_, b₂, b₃⟩ := body_case.mp hd.wf.2.1
    rcases ih rfl der with v | h
    · rcases der.canonical_form_sum v with ⟨s, (rfl|rfl)⟩
      · refine ⟨_, .case_inl ?_ b₂ b₃⟩; cases v; assumption
      · refine ⟨_, .case_inr ?_ b₂ b₃⟩; cases v; assumption
    · exact ⟨_, .case h.choose_spec b₂ b₃⟩

  exists ChoiceBisim, .choice h
  intro s₁ s₂ hr μ

        first | exact h.follow_fst htr | exact h.follow_snd htr

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  have jr ⦃x y⦄ (h : x ⭢ₚ y) : Join ParallelReduction y x := ⟨_, .refl _, h⟩
  intro _ _ c h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing c
  · exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  · cases h₂
    · exact jr (.red_I _)
    · exact jr (.refl _)
    · next hp hq =>
      cases hp
      exact ⟨_, hq, .red_I _⟩
  · cases h₂
    · exact jr (.red_K ..)
    · exact jr (.refl _)
    · next hp _ =>
      obtain ⟨_, hd, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ hp
      exact ⟨_, hd, .red_K ..⟩
  · cases h₂
    · exact jr (.red_S ..)
    · exact jr (.refl _)
    · next hp hq =>
      obtain ⟨d, e, hd, he, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hp
      exact ⟨_, .par (.par hd hq) (.par he hq), .red_S ..⟩
  · next hx hy ihx ihy =>
    cases h₂
    · exact jr (.par hx hy)
    · cases hx
      exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hy⟩
    · obtain ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ hx
      exact ⟨_, .red_K .., hd⟩
    · obtain ⟨d, e, hd, he, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hx
      exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par hd hy) (.par he hy)⟩
    · next hp hq =>
      exact (ihx hp).elim fun d hd => (ihy hq).elim fun e he =>
        ⟨_, .par hd.1 he.1, .par hd.2 he.2⟩

theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro Hup Hinit
  have hl := UpdateStatesLength Hup
  have hr := InitStatesLength Hinit
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit hr (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined Hinit) Hup) $ InitStatesNodup Hinit, ?_⟩
  simp only [InitStatesUpdated Hinit, UpdateStatesUpdated Hup, updatedStates]
  rw [updatedStatesComm]
  · exact updatedStatesUpdate hl $ updatedStatesDefMonotone $ UpdateStatesDefined' Hup
  · rw [List.unzip_zip hl, List.unzip_zip hr]
    intro x hx hx'
    simpa [InitStatesNotDefined Hinit x hx'] using UpdateStatesDefined Hup x hx

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  set C := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF with hC
  have key (φs' φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
      ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * C * ofCrAnListF φs) =
        ι (C * 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * ofCrAnListF φs)) := by
    let l1 := (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
        ((φs' ++ φs).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel)) ++
      List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs'
    let l2 := List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs ++
      List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
        ((φs' ++ φs).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel)
    have hsp : C = ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ] -
        𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) • ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ] := by
      rw [hC, superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
      simp [← ofCrAnListF_append]
    have h12 : crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) = l1 ++ [φ, ψ] ++ l2 := by
      rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs = φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs by simp,
        insertionSort_of_eq_list crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [φ, ψ] φs (by simp_all)]
      simp only [l1, l2, List.append_assoc]
    have h21 : crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs) = l1 ++ [ψ, φ] ++ l2 := by
      rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs = φs' ++ [ψ, φ] ++ φs by simp,
        insertionSort_of_eq_list crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [ψ, φ] φs (by simp_all)]
      simp only [l1, l2, List.append_assoc]
    have h1 : crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φs) = l1 ++ l2 := by
      rw [crAnTimeOrderList, insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs]
      simp only [l1, l2, List.append_assoc]
    have h2 : ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * C * ofCrAnListF φs) =
        crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι C * ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
      rw [hsp]
      simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
        ← ofCrAnListF_append, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
      rw [map_sub, map_smul, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, h12, h21]
      simp only [map_sub, map_smul, map_mul, ofCrAnListF_append, mul_sub, sub_mul,
        Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul]
      rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ φs' φs]
      module
    rw [h2]
    conv_rhs => rw [← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, h1, map_mul, map_smul,
      ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
    by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
    · rw [hC, Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)
        (ι (ofCrAnListF l1)), mul_assoc, crAnTimeOrderSign,
        Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq.symm, ← crAnTimeOrderSign]
    · rw [hC, ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq]
      simp
  have h1 (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
      ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ timeOrderF ∘ₗ LinearMap.mulRight ℂ (ofCrAnListF φs) ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.mulRight ℂ C =
      ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ C ∘ₗ timeOrderF ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.mulRight ℂ (ofCrAnListF φs) :=
    LinearMap.ext_on_range ofCrAnListFBasis.span_eq fun ψs => by
      simpa only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply,
        LinearMap.mulRight_apply, AlgHom.coe_toLinearMap] using key ψs φs
  have h2 : ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ timeOrderF ∘ₗ LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (a * C) =
      ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ C ∘ₗ timeOrderF ∘ₗ LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ a :=
    LinearMap.ext_on_range ofCrAnListFBasis.span_eq fun φs => by
      simpa only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply,
        LinearMap.mulRight_apply, AlgHom.coe_toLinearMap] using DFunLike.congr_fun (h1 φs) a
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h2 b

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiber := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1) (h_i_add_steps := by omega) y
  let q := qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have h39 (k : Fin 2) :
      f_i (fiber k) = P₀.eval (y : L) + (fiber k : L) * P₁.eval (y : L) := by
    have hq : q.eval ((fiber k : L)) = (y : L) := by
      have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i (steps := 1) (by omega)
        (fiber k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
      rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiber k)] at h
      exact (Subtype.coe_inj.mpr h).symm
    simp only [f_i]
    rw [show P_i = P₀.comp q + Polynomial.X * P₁.comp q from
        evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  have hd : (fiber 1 : L) - (fiber 0 : L) = 1 := by
    have e := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y
    simp only [fiber, e, Submodule.coe_add, Fin2ToF2,
      if_neg (by decide : (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0), ↓reduceIte, one_smul, zero_smul, zero_add,
      add_sub_cancel_right, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩
        (by omega : ↑i < ℓ + 𝓡)]
  have hpoly : P_i_plus_1 = Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, P₀, P₁, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      intermediateEvaluationPoly, Polynomial.C_mul, Polynomial.C_add,
      mul_sum, ← sum_add_distrib]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro x _
    ring
  rw [hpoly]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, f_i_plus_1, fold]
  rw [h39 0, h39 1, eq_add_of_sub_eq hd]
  ring

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let C : Submodule L _ := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt i.isLt⟩
  let d_i := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt i.isLt⟩
  let d_is := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨↑i + steps, Nat.lt_succ_of_le h_i_add_steps⟩
  let Y (g : C) : Set _ := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  let X : Type _ := ↥(sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let Q (x : X) := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
  let K (x : X) := pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β ⟨i, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt i.isLt⟩ steps h_i_add_steps x
  let Z : Type _ := ↥(sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨↑i + steps, by omega⟩)
  let F : Z → Finset X := fun y => Finset.image
    (qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ steps (fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) y)
    Finset.univ
  have hc (g : C) : hammingDist f g ≤ (Y g).ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    haveI : Fintype (Y g) := Fintype.ofFinite _
    calc hammingDist f g
        ≤ ((Y g).toFinset.biUnion F).card :=
          Finset.card_le_card (s := Finset.univ.filter (fun x : X => f x ≠ (g : _ → L) x))
            fun x hx => Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨Q x, Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl,
              (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨K x, Finset.mem_univ _,
                (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps (x := x) (y := Q x)).mp
                  rfl⟩⟩
      _ ≤ (Y g).toFinset.card * 2 ^ steps :=
          Finset.card_biUnion_le_card_mul _ _ _ fun _ _ =>
            Finset.card_image_le.trans (by rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin])
      _ = (Y g).ncard * 2 ^ steps := by rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
  obtain ⟨g', _, hg'⟩ := (Set.mem_image _ _ _).mp
    (Nat.sInf_mem ⟨_, Set.mem_image_of_mem _ (Set.mem_univ (0 : C))⟩)
  have h_alg : (d_is - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1 := by
    dsimp only [d_is, d_i, BBF_CodeDistance]
    rw [← Nat.sub_sub, ← Nat.sub_sub, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.pow_add,
      Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps)
        (Nat.sub_le_sub_right (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡) ↑i)),
      Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps), Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  exact ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g' g'.2).trans
        (Nat.cast_le.mpr ((hc g').trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hg'.le))))) zero_le_two).trans
      (Nat.cast_mul 2 _).symm.le |>.trans_lt (Nat.cast_lt.mpr (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (by
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← h_alg]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)))
      (Nat.sub_one_lt (Nat.succ_ne_zero _))))

theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  set f := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3)) with fdef
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hf⟩ :=
    Finite.exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem (f := f) (ht := Set.finite_Icc (B,B,B,B) (T,T,T,T))
      fun n => by simp only [fdef, Set.mem_Icc, Prod.le_def, hB, and_self]
  have hrec n := (hu (n + 4) (by omega)).1
  have hstep : ∀ a b, f a = f b → f (a + 1) = f (b + 1) := by
    intro a b h
    simp only [fdef, Prod.mk.injEq] at h ⊢
    exact ⟨h.2.1, h.2.2.1, h.2.2.2, Int.cast_inj.1 (by rw [hrec, hrec]; simp only [h, Nat.reduceSubDiff])⟩
  exact ⟨i, j - i, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij, fun n hn => by

theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f ⟨hde, hef⟩
  let w : Fin 9 → ℤ := fun j => 10 ^ (j : ℕ)
  have hE : ∀ x, digits_to_num x = ∑ j, x j * w j := fun x => congrFun hdigits_to_num x
  have key (x y : Fin 9 → ℤ) (i : Fin 9) :
      digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then y j else x j) = digits_to_num x + (y i - x i) * w i := by
    rw [hE]
    calc (∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then y j else x j) * w j)
        = ∑ j : Fin 9, (x j * w j + if j = i then (y j - x j) * w j else 0) :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by split_ifs <;> ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hE, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq', if_pos (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  have hd2 : ∀ i, 7 ∣ digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * w i := fun i => (key d e i) ▸ ((hrelation d e).mp hde).2 i
  have hf2 : ∀ i, 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * w i := fun i => (key e f i) ▸ ((hrelation e f).mp hef).2 i
  intro i
  have h5 : 7 ∣ (d i - f i) * w i := by
    convert (dvd_neg (a := (7 : ℤ))).mpr
      ((((hd2 i).add (hf2 i)).sub (Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun k _ => hd2 k))).add
        (⟨digits_to_num d, rfl⟩ : 7 ∣ 7 * digits_to_num d)) using 1
    simp only [hE, Finset.sum_add_distrib, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_fin,
      nsmul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hci : IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) (10 : ℤ) := ⟨-7, 5, by decide⟩
  exact (hci.pow_right : IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) (w i)).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right h5
